item.description: The Prime Minister instructed the defense establishment to evacuate outposts established in Area B following heavy pressure from the US administration.

item.description: Sen. Bernie Sanders calls for an end to the Iran war, saying the conflict is driving up gasoline prices and “wreaking havoc" on the US economy.

item.description: Tens of thousands attend central Selichot prayers at the Western Wall. Smotrich: "We prayed for the success of our soldiers and for victory for the national camp."

item.title: Munich Olympics, 54 years later: When Germany failed the Jews again
item.description: When it came to murdering Jews, the Germans were experts. In saving them, they turned out to be catastrophic incompetents. Opinion.

item.title: Haredi shakeup: Gafni, Maklev reportedly ousted from Degel HaTorah slate
item.description: Degel HaTorah party sources say rabbis have decided to replace veteran MKs Moshe Gafni and Uri Maklev, potentially ending Gafni’s 38-year Knesset career.

item.title: Live From Jerusalem: Heartfelt song and prayer at annual Selichot gathering
item.description: Yitzhak Meir leads a powerful night of Selichot, music and prayer at the Jerusalem Convention Center as worshippers prepare for the High Holy Days.

item.title: Bacon protest sparks kashrut controversy at Ichilov Hospital
item.description: Hospital throws out dishes after bacon is placed on them in protest over Shabbat closure of new maternity ward food machines.

item.title: East Jerusalem man indicted over weapons deal with Hamas agent
item.description: An East Jerusalem resident allegedly sold an M16 rifle to a Hamas-linked activist accused of plotting attacks against Minister Ben Gvir.

item.title: Learning optimism from Selichot
item.description: He says that when we enter into the period of Selichot, it would be totally understandable if we were filled with anxiety and dread - but we can feel optimistic.

item.title: Netanya shooting: Suspect likely suffering combat trauma declared dead
item.description: Armed security forces member believed to suffer from combat trauma declared dead after opening fire on police in Netanya.

item.title: UN presents a new world map
item.description: The UN General Assembly overwhelmingly approves a push for a new world map, challenging centuries-old distortions that make Africa appear far smaller than it really is.

item.title: The English city where the West goes to die
item.description: Birmingham City Council decided to ban the English flag and the flag of St George. For "public safety." Opinion.

item.title: Dramatic rescue: Man pulled alive from underground Jerusalem garbage container
item.description: Firefighters battle oxygen shortage and explosive gases for over an hour before rescuing trapped man from one-ton garbage container in Gilo.

item.title: DOJ civil rights chief: Antisemitism is a ‘national crisis’
item.description: Harmeet Dhillon tells Israeli-American leaders Justice Department is using 'hard power' of US government to fight antisemitism on campuses and across country.

item.title: Trump hosts rare White House meeting with Hasidic leaders
item.description: A historic gathering brings prominent Hasidic leaders from New York and New Jersey face-to-face with President Trump in the Oval Office, including an extraordinary Satmar reunion.

item.title: IDF: Interceptor launched near Gaza toward false target
item.description:
IDF: A short while ago, an interceptor was launched toward a false target that was later identified as IDF fire from operations conducted within the southern Gaza Strip area.
No injuries were reported. The incident is under review.
No sirens were sounded in the communities in accordance with protocol.

item.title: IDF weighs major pullback from southern Lebanon
item.description: Emerging plan would see IDF troops leave forward positions, redeploy along a new 'Gray Line' just kilometers from Israel's northern border.

item.title: Iran plots to keep US under pressure until November elections
item.description: Arab diplomats say Tehran may prolong its controlled escalation with the United States to pressure President Trump ahead of the midterm elections.

item.title: Hezbollah drone targets IDF troops, Israel strikes back
item.description: IDF intercepts Hezbollah drone over the Lebanon security zone before striking terrorists and weapons storage facilities used to plan attacks.

item.title: Huckabee pulled out his phone and filmed Jewish settlers
item.description: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee met with American citizens living near Ramallah, pulled out his cellphone to film Jews near the area.
